title: podcast-explainer-video scenes.json
description: Visual choreography. Scenes and cues are anchored to turns or words, never to times; build_manifest.py resolves anchors to milliseconds. See references/manifest.md and references/visuals.md.

conceptAngle.description: One sentence that names the persistent concept world.

tailMs.description: Hold after the audio ends. build_manifest.py clamps it to 500..3000.

point.description: A moment in the audio. {turn} = turn start; {turn, edge:'end'} = turn end; {turn, word} = start of that word or phrase (occurrence counts from 1); {ms} = absolute escape hatch.

segment.description: Optional. The script segment this scene belongs to, for redo bookkeeping.

worldSteps.description: Steps that continue the persistent world (shared timeline); the component draws it with useSharedWorld + WorldCanvas.

persist.description: Keep the chip after the next visual step. Default: it ends at the next step after its start (at least 700 ms), because a chip is a label for one state. Use persist for a term, never for a count or state that a later step changes.

earlyOk.description: W18: the reason a number on this step's labels (stat, note, set value or label, banner text or side labels, chip text) shows before the words speak it, for a picture meant to lead (a cold-open prompt, the same quantity in other words). qc.py labels.early lists it as reviewed; an unreviewed early label fails qc.py all --final.

countClaim.description: A structured count claim, checked by qc.py labels.counts against a compare table's two rows over the columns filled in both, whatever the wording. columns-changed counts columns whose cells differ; cells-changed-to counts columns whose cells differ and whose second-row cell is `to`. W13b (Q05): the label text may write its numbers as placeholders {value}, {of} and {to}, which the renderer fills from the claim; a written "N of M" (or "N out of M", "N/M") that differs from value and of stops the render and build_manifest.py.

of.description: The denominator the label states (the table's column count).

to.description: cells-changed-to only: the new cell text.

side.description: The table panel. Default: a stat's own panel, else the only table panel.

oneOf.description: An item id: the arrow walks clockwise to its successor (the next visible owner) and ends at that owner.

to.description: The owner the arrow ends at. It must be the item's successor at this step unless overshoot is true; build_manifest.py and the renderer reject a mismatch.

overshoot.description: The walk passes the successor on purpose (for example replicas on the next servers); drawn dashed in the bad colour.

width.description: World units. Default 1728 (one unit = one pixel at zoom 1).

layout.description: ring: nodes with pos or angle sit on a circle (references/visuals.md, ring layout).

positions.description: Slots on the ring; pos runs 0..positions-1 clockwise from 12 o'clock.

r.description: Radius of the ring line in world units. Default 0.31 x min(width, height).

ownership.description: clockwise (default): each item node takes the colour of the next owner node clockwise.

ownershipAt.description: Items stay grey until this word (the rule is spoken); an item named in a walk colours when its walk ends.

nodes.description: Every node of the episode world, hidden ones included (a scene hides and reveals them). Keep about 32 or fewer on screen at once.

route.description: Route recall (references/memory-palace.md): ordered stations. Station numbers run 1..n in order; their segments follow script order.

value.description: A label for the state at the node's reveal: it disappears at the next step on its timeline unless persist is true. Change it with set.

persist.description: Keep the node's own value after the next step.

anchorImage.description: Small glyph (about 56 px) drawn in the node corner; a route station's anchor.

pos.description: Ring layout: slot 0..positions-1 clockwise from 12 o'clock; build_manifest.py writes x and y.

angle.description: Ring layout: degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock, instead of pos.

ringOffset.description: Ring layout: radial offset from the ring line (+ = outside), world units.

role.description: Ring layout: an item takes the colour of the next visible owner clockwise.

virtualOf.description: W13b: this owner is one of several points of one server (virtual node). Names the server (usually the plain owner's id); the colour defaults to that node's colour and the label draws with a point subscript (A1, A2).

point.description: W13b: the subscript drawn after the label of a virtual node. Default: the node's 1-based index among nodes with the same virtualOf.

markPersist.description: W13b: marks (focus, focusEdges, arcs, the automatic change band with its moved outlines, tint, walk arrows) end at the next step by default. true keeps every mark this step sets until a later step sets that kind again; a list keeps only those kinds.

persist.description: Keep value and label after the next step. Default: they show until the next step on the same timeline, then the node shows no value and its own label. color always stays.

earlyOk.description: W18: the reason a number on this step's labels (stat, note, set value or label, banner text or side labels, chip text) shows before the words speak it, for a picture meant to lead (a cold-open prompt, the same quantity in other words). qc.py labels.early lists it as reviewed; an unreviewed early label fails qc.py all --final.

speaksOf.description: W13b: nodes the words of this step talk about. The renderer never dims them while the step is current; build_manifest.py warns when a focus dims a node the words name.

focus.description: Spotlight: these nodes get the focus ring, all others dim. Until the next step unless persist; [] clears.

focusEdges.description: Until the next step unless persist; [] clears.

hide.description: Nodes or edges fade out and stay hidden until a later reveal.

walk.description: Ring layout: an arrow walks clockwise from each item and ends at its owner (the successor, or `to` with overshoot). It ends at the next step or at the end of its anchor turn (plus hold), whichever is first, at least 1.5 s; persist keeps it until a later step walks.

arcs.description: Ring layout: highlighted ranges. Until the next step unless persist; [] clears (also clears the automatic change arc).

freeze.description: Ring layout: true holds item colours (a server can appear while the learner predicts); false recolours with the change band and moved outlines, which end at the next step unless this step has persist "change".

tint.description: Colour class -> node ids: a solid outline in that colour (theme name or #hex) around each node, replacing the moved outline. Until the next step unless persist; {} clears. Splits a set of items by what happened to them.

note.description: A callout for this step only; it disappears at the next step.

hide.description: Elements fade out on this step and stay hidden (an element's first hide step counts). Use it to move a part: hide the old copy, reveal a new one.

matrixRef.description: A 0-based index or the header text (use the index when a header repeats).

matrixProps.description: W16: a score or weight grid between two sets of words (references/visuals.md, matrix). Text never draws under 28 px: build_manifest.py and the renderer refuse a matrix that cannot fit, with the largest column count that would.

cells.description: One row per row header, one entry per column; "" leaves a cell blank.

heat.description: Optional heatmap intensity 0..1 per cell, same shape as cells.

rowAxis.description: Caption for the row headers, e.g. "query".

colAxis.description: Caption for the column headers, e.g. "key".

highlight.description: {row, col} marks a cell, {row} a whole row, {col} a whole column. Lasts until the next step unless persist.

note.description: Shown under the grid until the next step.

earlyOk.description: W18: the reason a number on this step's labels (stat, note, set value or label, banner text or side labels, chip text) shows before the words speak it, for a picture meant to lead (a cold-open prompt, the same quantity in other words). qc.py labels.early lists it as reviewed; an unreviewed early label fails qc.py all --final.

W18: the reason a number on this step's labels (stat, note, set value or label, banner text or side labels, chip text) shows before the words speak it, for a picture meant to lead (a cold-open prompt, the same quantity in other words). qc.py labels.early lists it as reviewed; an unreviewed early label fails qc.py all --final.

checkProps.description: Answered retrieval card: answer and/or correct with answerAt (the answer shows on that word, zero lead). Final self-test card: question (and options) only; nothing is revealed.

earlyOk.description: W18: the reason a number on this step's labels (stat, note, set value or label, banner text or side labels, chip text) shows before the words speak it, for a picture meant to lead (a cold-open prompt, the same quantity in other words). qc.py labels.early lists it as reviewed; an unreviewed early label fails qc.py all --final.

tint.description: Colour class -> node ids: a solid outline in that colour (theme name or #hex) around each node, replacing the moved outline. Until the next step unless persist; {} clears. Splits a set of items by what happened to them.

title.description: Replaces the panel title from this word on (zero lead); inherited.

tag.description: Replaces the tag pill from this word on (zero lead); inherited; "" hides it.

fill.description: Table: row id -> columns shown on this cue (zero lead), cumulative. A row named in any fill shows ? until filled.

persist.description: Keep the stat after the panel's next step.

stat.description: Result line under the panel; shows on its word with zero lead until the panel's next step (unless persist); "" clears it. The object form carries persist and a count claim.

marks.description: Table: row id -> 0-based columns outlined; inherited; {} clears.

cellTint.description: Table: colour class -> row id -> 0-based columns: a solid outline in that colour, replacing the dashed mark. Splits cells by what happened to them. Inherited; {} clears.

world.description: kind world: "shared" continues the episode world (its steps join the global timeline), or a local world for this panel only.

columns.description: Table headers (W16: up to 12 characters; a cell widens to hold its text, and the 28 px rule still refuses a table that cannot fit). Every row needs exactly one cell per column. The layout must keep text at 28 px or more at 1080p (references/visuals.md, table limits); build_manifest.py and the renderer reject a table that cannot, with the numbers.

label.description: W13b: the row-label column grows from 180 px to hold the longest label at the table text size, up to 320 px (14 characters at 36 px); a longer label shrinks, and one that would draw under 28 px (over 18 characters) is refused with the numbers.

cells.description: Exactly one cell per column (no padding); a row of another length is rejected.

verdict.description: The first banner. Only on its word do the panels turn green (right) and red (wrong).

banners.description: Later banners. Each replaces the verdict or the banner before it on its word (zero lead): change the text when the first verdict stops being true, set winner none to make the panels neutral again, or text "" to hide the badge.

text.description: "" hides the badge (winner and labels still apply).

labels.description: Pill text per side in place of RIGHT / WRONG, for example "moves 9 of 12". With winner none the pills are neutral.

persist.description: Keep the banner after the next step of either panel. Default: it ends there and the panels turn neutral.
